# Mini Engineer — navig-mini

> Lightweight NAVIG build. Every byte counts.

## Domain

- Minimal feature set — only essential agent interactions
- Optimized bundle, fast cold start
- Shared types from `navig-shared`

## Laws

- No heavy frameworks — prefer vanilla or minimal libs
- Bundle size budget: track and never regress
- `tsc --noEmit` must pass
- Feature parity with core UX — no UX regressions for supported features
